Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

Score Step 6 (ZimmProductCard organism) — round 2, after rework. Round 1 required exactly 2 fixes (a 3rd was correctly deferred, see below).

## Round 1 required:
1. **Close-button lift rule broke its own positioning.** `[data-card-slot="close"]: {position:'relative', zIndex:1}` had HIGHER specificity than Media's own `position:'absolute'` on that element, so the organism's rule won the cascade and the wishlist remove button fell out of its pinned top-right position into normal document flow — a real, visible-on-first-paint bug, independently confirmed by the prior Tester via actual `getComputedStyle` on a real (unmocked) render. Fix: remove the competing `position:'relative'`, keep only `zIndex:1` (the element is already positioned by Media's own recipe, so z-index alone suffices).
2. **Size chips unreachable by keyboard.** The size-chip reveal was gated ONLY on `&:hover` (nested under the hover-capable media query) with no `:focus-within` equivalent — `display:none` removes an element from the tab order, so a keyboard user tabbing through a hover-capable desktop could never reach the size chips at all. Fix: add `:focus-within` alongside every `:hover` reveal rule (price-hide, price-reveal, size-chip-reveal), matching the established `_hover`/`_focusWithin` sibling-key idiom already used in `zimmSearchInput.css.ts` and `globalStyles.ts`.

**Fix 3 (mobile PLP shows the bag icon, Figma hides it) was correctly NOT attempted** — the Implementer evaluated two candidate CSS selectors and rejected both as unsafe: a nesting-depth selector would ALSO hide the size chips (proven by reading ZimmSizeChip/ZimmSizeChipGroup's real DOM depth, identical to the bag button's), and an `aria-label`-presence selector "happens to" uniquely match today but relies on an undocumented coincidence of Content's current implementation, not a real contract. The Implementer correctly identified this needs a new `data-card-slot="bag"` attribute added to the ALREADY-COMMITTED `zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx` (Step 5), which is out of this step's file scope and needs explicit sign-off before touching a previously-committed file. This is being routed to Marcel as a separate decision, not something to score as a defect in this round.

## Implementer's round-2 report claims

**Fix 1**: removed `position:'relative'` from the `close` lift key only (the other two lift rules — `[data-card-slot="carousel"] button`, `[data-card-slot="content"] button` — were correctly left untouched since THEIR target elements have no prior `position` set, confirmed by reading those owning recipes). Added a test reading the real recipe object (confirms `close` has `zIndex:1` and no `position` key at all), plus a DOM-level test rendering the real Media `close` recipe + organism `root` recipe together and reading `getComputedStyle` — ran BOTH tests against the pre-fix code first and both failed for the exact expected reason (position:'relative' present / computed as relative), then passed after the fix, with the DOM test now showing `position:'absolute', top:'0px', right:'0px'`.

**Fix 2**: added `:focus-within` sibling keys next to every `:hover` reveal rule. Made an important, honest correction to the task's own assumption: discovered that `window.getComputedStyle()` in this project's jsdom does NOT dynamically re-resolve pseudo-class-gated rules after a real focus change post-mount (verified with throwaway diagnostics, since removed) — even though `document.activeElement`/`element.matches(':focus-within')` correctly reflect real focus state, and `fireEvent.focus()` doesn't move `document.activeElement` at all (only a real `.focus()` call does). Given that, switched the interaction proof to use `.matches()` against the literal descendant-selector suffix the real recipe emits (with only the Emotion `&` swapped for a stand-in ancestor selector), rather than `getComputedStyle()` — documented this deviation inline in the test file so it's traceable, not silent. Two tests: focus on a descendant flips the reveal selector from non-matching to matching; focus on a sibling OUTSIDE the card root never does.

**Verification claimed**: `tsc` clean, own suite 30/30 (was 26, +4 new tests), `recipeParts.test.ts` 29/29, `recipeGuards.test.ts` 6/6, eslint clean, audit:tokens only the pre-existing unrelated footer.css.ts finding, full suite 52 files/824 tests (was 820, +4). Only `zimmProductCard.css.ts` and `index.test.tsx` modified (confirmed via mtime); `index.tsx`/`index.stories.tsx` untouched.

## Your job

1. Read the actual current content of the `close` lift rule, the `:focus-within` additions, and the new/modified tests — confirm claims are literally true, not just asserted.
2. Independently re-verify BOTH falsification claims yourself: re-break Fix 1 (reintroduce `position:'relative'` on the close rule) and confirm the new tests catch it; and check whether the jsdom `getComputedStyle`-doesn't-update claim for Fix 2 is real by trying it yourself (or reading the test file closely enough to confirm the `.matches()`-based proof is methodologically sound and not a weaker test in disguise).
3. Re-run:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
git status --porcelain
```
4. Confirm scope is still exactly the 2 files, nothing else — in particular confirm `zimmProductCardMedia/`, `zimmProductCardContent/`, and every other already-committed Step 1-5 file remains byte-for-byte untouched.
5. Judge whether the `.matches()`-based interaction proof for Fix 2 is an acceptable substitute for the originally-requested `getComputedStyle()` check, given the Implementer's claimed jsdom limitation — is this a legitimate methodological correction or a weakening of the test's actual guarantee?

This is round 2 of a 3-round max — factor that in. Give PASS or REWORK. If PASS, note explicitly that the real-browser visual/interaction check (confirming the stretched-link z-index layering actually works when a real browser does real hit-testing, not just jsdom's declarative CSS resolution) is STILL OUTSTANDING and must happen before this step is truly done — that check is not something a Scorer round can substitute for.

8	 * together off the exact same media feature, on this shared root.
9	 */

12	type ZimmProductCardStyleProps = {
13	  /** Home only — see VARIATION_CONFIG in index.tsx. Price is hidden at every breakpoint/pointer

19	  /** PLP + Wishlist — the size-chip picker is hidden at every breakpoint/pointer type by default
20	   *  and only appears once a hover-capable pointer actually hovers the card, in the same
21	   *  media-query gate as the price swap above so both engage together. */
22	  hoverRevealsSizeSelector?: boolean;
23	};

25	/**
26	 * Recipe for the product-card organism (ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard) — composes
27	 * ZimmProductCardMedia (Step 4) and ZimmProductCardContent (Step 5) with no styling of its own
28	 * for either child. This recipe's entire job is the cross-component concerns neither child can
29	 * own by itself:
30	 *
31	 *   1. THE STRETCHED-LINK OVERLAY. ZimmProductCardContent's `nameLink` renders the one real `<a>`
32	 *      in the whole composed tree. Its `::after` is stretched to `inset: 0` against THIS
33	 *      component's own `root` — the nearest positioned ancestor. Confirmed by reading
34	 *      `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts` directly: neither its `root` nor `nameRow`, `nameLink`, or
35	 *      any other part sets `position` anywhere in that file, so nothing between the `<a>` and
36	 *      this `root` intercepts the containing-block chain. (`ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own `root`
37	 *      IS `position: relative`, but Media is a *sibling* of Content under this organism's root,
38	 *      never an ancestor of Content's `<a>`, so it has no bearing on this chain.)
39	 *   2. LIFTING EVERY OTHER INTERACTIVE CONTROL above that overlay — a z-index higher than the
40	 *      overlay's own (left unset), or the invisible overlay would intercept their clicks first.
41	 *      Three separate, single-selector keys rather than one comma-joined selector: verified via
42	 *      this project's own installed Stylis (v4.2.0 — the same engine Emotion/Chakra invoke at
43	 *      runtime, confirmed by direct compilation) that a comma-separated list DOES distribute this
44	 *      recipe's generated class across every branch correctly, but three plain keys need no such
45	 *      verification to trust at a glance and are each individually addressable from a test. Only
46	 *      TWO of the three (`carousel`/`content` buttons) also add `position: relative` — those
47	 *      elements are `position: static` by default in their own component recipes, so a positioned
48	 *      ancestor is needed for z-index to apply at all. The `close` button is the one exception:
49	 *      `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own `close` recipe part already sets `position: absolute` on it
50	 *      directly, so it needs (and, as of the Fix 1 rework below, gets) only the z-index bump here
51	 *      — a competing `position` value previously declared alongside it had HIGHER specificity
52	 *      than Media's own rule (this rule is a class+attribute descendant selector; Media's is a
53	 *      single class) and silently won the cascade, knocking the remove button out of its pinned
54	 *      top-right corner into normal document flow. See the inline comment at that key below and
55	 *      index.test.tsx's "Fix 1" describe blocks for the proof.
56	 *   3. THE HOVER-REVEAL SWAP between price and the PLP/Wishlist size-selector (and Home's
57	 *      hidden-by-default price), gated by the same `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` query
58	 *      `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` already uses for its own arrows/indicator split. Each reveal
59	 *      rule fires on `:hover` OR `:focus-within` on this same root (Fix 2 rework below) — `:hover`
60	 *      alone would leave every reveal permanently unreachable by keyboard on a hover-capable
61	 *      device, since `display: none` removes the unconditional-state element from the tab order

64	 * Parts: only `root` is declared. Everything above is a nested descendant selector inside
65	 * `root`'s own style object (targeting the composed children's `data-card-slot` attributes), not
66	 * a separate Chakra part — `index.tsx` never reads anything off `useMultiStyleConfig` but
67	 * `styles.root`, so `recipeParts.test.ts`'s declared-vs-read reconciliation needs nothing more.
68	 *

70	 * .claude/rules/conventions.md's own exception ("0, 1, -1 in obvious idiomatic uses"): it is the
71	 * standard "one level above the default/auto stacking layer" value, used identically at each of

78

82	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,

91	      '[data-card-slot="content"] a::after': {

95	      },
96

101	      // wrapper are all real <button> descendants of [data-card-slot="content"].
102	      // Fix 1 (Scorer rework round 1): NO position value here. ZimmProductCardMedia's own
103	      // `close` recipe part already sets `position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0` on this exact
104	      // element (that's how the remove button pins to the image's top-right corner). This rule's
105	      // `.css-root [data-card-slot="close"]` descendant+attribute selector has HIGHER
106	      // specificity than Media's own single-class rule, so a competing `position` value declared
107	      // here would win the cascade and knock the button out of its pinned position into normal
108	      // flow — which is exactly what shipped here before this fix. The element is already
109	      // positioned (by Media's own recipe), which is all `zIndex` needs to take effect; no
110	      // `position` re-declaration was ever necessary. See index.test.tsx's "Fix 1" describe
111	      // blocks for the object-shape and real-DOM/getComputedStyle proof.
112	      '[data-card-slot="close"]': {
113	        zIndex: 1,
114	      },
115	      '[data-card-slot="carousel"] button': {
116	        position: 'relative',
117	        zIndex: 1,
118	      },
119	      '[data-card-slot="content"] button': {
120	        position: 'relative',
121	        zIndex: 1,
122	      },
123	
124	      // 3. Hover-reveal swap — see docblock point 3. The unconditional (outside-media-query)
125	      // half of each flag below is what makes a touch/no-hover pointer see the *default* state
126	      // permanently: it never matches HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY at all, so whichever rule fired outside
127	      // it (or the total absence of one) is the only state that pointer type ever sees.
128	      ...(hoverRevealsPrice && {
129	        // Home: price starts hidden at every breakpoint/pointer type...
130	        '[data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="price"]': { display: 'none' },
131	      }),
132	      ...(hoverRevealsSizeSelector && {
133	        // PLP/Wishlist: size-selector starts hidden at every breakpoint/pointer type...
134	        '[data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="sizeChips"]': { display: 'none' },
135	      }),
136	
137	      [HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY]: {
138	        ...(hoverRevealsPrice && {
139	          // ...and is only revealed here, once a hover-capable pointer actually hovers the card.
140	          '&:hover [data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="price"]': { display: 'block' },
141	          // Fix 2 (Scorer rework round 1): `display: none` removes an element from the tab

148	          // `'&:hover, &:focus-within ...'` selector) to match that same established idiom;

150	          // `_focusWithin` shorthand props because the descendant-combinator path has to be
151	          // baked into the selector itself.
152	          '&:focus-within [data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="price"]': { display: 'block' },
153	        }),
154	        ...(hoverHidesPrice && {
155	          // PLP/Wishlist: price is visible by default (no unconditional rule needed above) and
156	          // hides only here, in favour of the size-selector reveal alongside it.
157	          '&:hover [data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="price"]': { display: 'none' },

162	          '&:focus-within [data-card-slot="content"] [data-card-slot="price"]': { display: 'none' },
